text: Evolution Festival was an annual music festival held in Newcastle upon Tyne and Gateshead, England, from 2002 to 2013.[1][2] It drew tens of thousands of attendees each year and typically took place on the Quayside.[3] The festival was briefly known as Orange Evolution due to a sponsorship agreement with the mobile phone company Orange.[4] It has been described as "the biggest festival Tyneside has ever staged".[5] Headline acts included Dizzee Rascal, The Wombats, Paolo Nutini, and Maxïmo Park.[6][7][8] Florence + The Machine, Amy Winehouse, and Ellie Goulding performed at the festival before achieving widespread fame.[9][10][11] The event first took place on the Quayside in 2003, with performances by Moloko, Biffy Clyro, and Inspiral Carpets.[13] In 2004, due to funding issues, it reverted to a multi-venue format, including a Shindig event headlined by Eric Morillo and Deep Dish.[14] It returned to the Quayside in 2005, sponsored by Orange, with a three-stage lineup headlined by Dizzee Rascal and The Futureheads.[15] Maxïmo Park headlined the 2007 event.[8] In 2008, the festival ended its sponsorship with Orange and reverted to being called Evolution Festival, introducing a £3 entry charge for the first time.[16] In 2009, it expanded to a two-day format with performances by The Wombats, White Lies, and Florence + The Machine.[6] A folk stage was added in 2010.[7] In 2012, a one-off edition was held at Avenham Park, Preston, as part of the Preston Guild celebrations, titled GFest, featuring Maverick Sabre, Labrinth, and Stooshe and attracting thousands of attendees.[17][18] The 2013 main event in Newcastle featured The Vaccines, Ellie Goulding, Paloma Faith, and Jake Bugg.[19] In 2014, the festival did not take place, and although organisers Jim Mawdsley and Dave Stone stated it was only a "pause", the event has not been held since.[2] The Evolution brand continues through Evolution Emerging, a multiple venue event showcasing local new bands, which operated until 2019 when it rebranded into Tipping Point live.[12]
